svg.title: Time stepping for the continuity equation
svg.desc: Initialize the face coefficients once. At each step, supply sources, losses and inflows, select a time step, form the fluxes using the old density and update the density semi-implicitly. Check the discrete balance before advancing the clock.

g.text: Initialize the closure once, then advance the density
Set the initial density and physical start time separately
① Supply volume sources, loss frequency and inflow
Choose the time step for both stability and physical accuracy
② Compute face fluxes from the old density
Interior faces use the upstream value. Open faces combine inflow and outflow.
③ Sum the face contributions and update the density
Explicit transport and production, implicit linear loss
④ Check the new density and the change in total particles
Use old-density outflow and new-density loss. Advance the clock after checking.
Stop at the requested final time
